description: deixis-pos-v1 conformance vectors — the spelling κ : ℕ → Bytes of docs/design/0002-positional-keys.md. Hand-computed from the spec, not generated by an implementation. `keys` is listed in ascending position order, so a conforming implementation's outputs, sorted lexicographically by key bytes, must reproduce the file order (the order-preservation property). `invalid` lists byte strings that are not κ(i) for any i; a consumer recognizing positional structure must reject each, never normalize it to an index. Positions are decimal strings — some exceed exact JSON number range.

invalid.reason: empty — no run, no terminator, no magnitude
truncated — run promises a 2-byte magnitude, none present
truncated — run promises a 2-byte magnitude, got 1
malformed — after a zero-length ff-run the terminator 00 must follow, got 01
malformed — leading byte is neither ff (run) nor 00 (terminator)
non-shortest magnitude — 0001 has a leading zero; position 1 is spelled 0001
non-shortest magnitude — 00ff has a leading zero; position 255 is spelled 00ff
trailing bytes — κ(0) = 0000 followed by a stray 00; κ is prefix-free, so no valid key extends another
